snippet.title: ⁠Exoshock VR | Playtest App available now!
snippet.description:
Download the Exoshock Playtest App today. 
👉   / https://discord.gg/QHKzGN4k8S

Exoshock is a 1-4 player cooperative sci-fi VR shooter built for full-body immersion, cinematic combat, and relentless tactical action.

• Board hostile starships, breach compartments, and clear corridors under fire.  
• Dynamic objectives and reactive enemy AI that flanks, suppresses, grenades, and forces real teamwork.  
• Choose your approach: deploy drones and sentries, anchor the line with heavy weapons, or push the frontline.  
• Handcrafted starship layouts layered with procedural modifiers for high replayability.  
• Platforms: Meta Quest 3, PCVR via SteamVR. VR First with Flat Support

This is just the beginning. Join the Discord to sign up for a limited spot in the Closed Alpha and help shape the battlefield.

📌 Wishlist Exoshock today:  
➡️ Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/exos...  
➡️ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/35...  
📺 Subscribe for devlogs and gameplay:    / @exoshock
